_note: Per-material design: the blocks (type, column, heading) each lesson uses, in stacking order. Agents fill only these blocks. Anchors on every material: concepts + tips (left), decisions (right).

blocks.heading: Spark: driver and executors
blocks.why: show how one job is split into tasks over partitions on executors

blocks.heading: Narrow vs wide transformations
blocks.why: left = narrow (no shuffle), right = wide (shuffle); points in plain words

blocks.heading: Shard limits
blocks.why: the key numbers: write per shard, read per shard, EFO per consumer, retention

blocks.heading: Core Concepts
blocks.why: partition key / hot shards and producers (KPL, PutRecords)

blocks.heading: Shared vs enhanced fan-out
blocks.why: left = shared throughput, right = enhanced fan-out

blocks.heading: Retention and replay
blocks.why: axis from record written to max retention, marks for 24 h default, 7 days, 365 days and replay positions (TRIM_HORIZON, AT_TIMESTAMP, LATEST); no lanes

blocks.heading: Delivery pipeline
blocks.why: 5-6 stages left to right from source through buffering, transform, format conversion, dynamic partitioning to destinations; branch from the transform or delivery stage to the S3 error/backup prefix

blocks.heading: Kafka ↔ Kinesis vocabulary
blocks.why: left = Kafka term, right = Kinesis equivalent

blocks.heading: Flink window types
blocks.why: 3 lanes: Tumbling (back-to-back fixed bars), Sliding (overlapping bars), Session (bars separated by gaps of inactivity); axis = event time; no marks or at most 1

blocks.heading: When a batch fails
blocks.why: start: batch invoked -> decision: function error? -> no: checkpoint & next batch; yes: bisect enabled? -> split batch / retry whole batch -> decision: retries or record age left? -> retry; else -> on-failure destination, continue; 6-9 nodes

blocks.heading: ESM knobs
blocks.why: batch size, batching window, parallelization factor, retries/age
